sec.title: Batch 66 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 66 recovers and dates 18 classic radio broadcasts spanning educational historical docudramas, Golden Age daytime serial melodramas, and swashbuckling literary adventure serials: 6 founding episodes of the celebrated state historical series ***Pennsylvania: Keystone of Democracy*** (1941, produced by the Pennsylvania Historical Commission, covering George Washington at Valley Forge, the origins of the American steel industry, Stephen Foster, and the Pennsylvania long rifle), 6 consecutive serialized episodes of Frank and Anne Hummert's legendary NBC daytime soap opera ***Backstage Wife*** (May 1944, starring Claire Niesen as Mary Noble navigating the backstage murder of Oliver Wilson), and 6 serialized chapters of the 1939 syndicated adventure serial ***The Son of Porthos*** (adapting Alexandre Dumas' swashbuckling sequel to The Three Musketeers).

sec.title: 1. *Pennsylvania: Keystone of Democracy* — 1941 State Historical Series
